fields.name: dual_licensure_available
fields.description: Whether a single license can cover both speech-language pathology and audiology for a dually qualified applicant.
fields.sample_quote: An applicant who qualifies to be licensed as both a speech-language pathologist and audiologist shall receive a single license reflecting licensure in both classifications.

fields.name: license_disciplines
fields.description: The distinct professional disciplines for which separate licensure is available under the same regulatory chapter.
fields.sample_quote: Licensing shall be granted independently either in speech-language pathology or audiology. A person shall be licensed in one or both areas when the person meets the respective qualifications.

fields.name: temporary_license_available
fields.description: Whether a temporary license may be issued to applicants completing a clinical fellowship year prior to full licensure.
fields.sample_quote: The division may issue a temporary license to an applicant for an audiology license who … is practicing audiology in a year of clinical fellowship. The temporary license is valid for up to 12 months.

fields.name: temporary_license_duration_months
fields.description: Maximum duration in months of a temporary license issued during the clinical fellowship year.
fields.sample_quote: The temporary license is valid for up to 12 months.

fields.name: aide_classification_recognized
fields.description: Whether the statute formally recognizes a subordinate aide classification (audiology aide or speech-language pathology aide) with defined supervision requirements.
fields.sample_quote: 'Audiology aide' means an individual who … works under the personal direction and direct supervision of a licensed audiologist who accepts responsibility for the acts and performance of that audiology aide under this chapter.

fields.name: aide_supervision_level
fields.description: The required level of supervision a licensed professional must provide over an aide.
fields.sample_quote: works under the personal direction and direct supervision of a licensed speech-language pathologist who accepts the responsibility for the acts and performances of that speech-language pathology aide

fields.name: aide_independent_practice_prohibited
fields.description: Whether aides are explicitly prohibited from acting independently.
fields.sample_quote: does not act independently

fields.name: clinical_fellowship_year_required
fields.description: Whether a clinical fellowship year (CFY) is a recognized and required component of the licensure pathway.
fields.sample_quote: 'CFY' means the clinical fellowship year prescribed by ASHA.

fields.name: post_degree_experience_hours_per_week
fields.description: Minimum weekly hours of direct clinical experience required during the post-degree supervised professional experience period.
fields.sample_quote: at least one academic year of professional experience, at least 30 hours per week, of direct clinical experience in treatment and management of patients

fields.name: supervisor_credential_requirement
fields.description: Credentials the supervising professional must hold to qualify as a supervisor for post-degree clinical experience.
fields.sample_quote: supervised and attested to by one holding an audiologist license under this chapter, the CCC, or their full equivalent

fields.name: national_professional_certification_referenced
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly references a national professional certification (e.g., ASHA's Certificate of Clinical Competence) as a benchmark or alternative pathway.
fields.sample_quote: 'CCC' means the certificate of clinical competence awarded by the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association.

fields.name: doctoral_degree_required_after_date
fields.description: Whether a doctoral-level degree (AuD or equivalent) is required for audiologist licensure after a specified transition date.
fields.sample_quote: To obtain and maintain a license as an audiologist beginning July 1, 2010, an applicant must … provide the committee with verification that the applicant is the legal holder of a clinical doctor's degree or AuD, in audiology

fields.name: doctoral_degree_transition_date
fields.description: The date on or after which a doctoral degree became required for audiologist licensure.
fields.sample_quote: To obtain and maintain a license as an audiologist beginning July 1, 2010

fields.name: continuing_education_graduate_level_required
fields.description: Whether continuing education for license renewal must be at the graduate level and clinically related to the profession.
fields.sample_quote: At the time of renewal the licensee shall show satisfactory evidence of completion of scheduled graduate level professional training, related clinically to the profession of speech-language pathology or audiology

fields.name: hearing_aid_sale_consumer_protections
fields.description: Whether the statute imposes specific consumer-protection requirements on licensees who sell hearing aids, such as mandatory written receipts and cancellation rights.
fields.sample_quote: A person licensed under this chapter who sells a hearing aid to a consumer shall provide a written receipt or written contract to the consumer that provides the consumer with a 30-day right to cancel the purchase

fields.name: hearing_aid_return_period_days
fields.description: Number of days a consumer has to return a hearing aid for a refund after purchase.
fields.sample_quote: a 30-day right to cancel the purchase and to obtain a refund if the consumer returns the hearing aid to the seller in the same condition as when purchased

fields.name: hearing_aid_ada_compatibility_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether licensees selling hearing aids must inform consumers about ADA-compatible assistive listening systems.
fields.sample_quote: A person licensed under this chapter who offers to sell a hearing aid to a consumer shall inform the consumer about hearing aids that work with assistive listening systems that are compliant with the ADA Standards for Accessible Design

fields.name: telehealth_authorized
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes delivery of audiology or speech-language pathology services via telehealth.
fields.sample_quote: 'Telehealth' means the application of electronic communication or information technology that meets the applicable standard of care to deliver audiology or speech-language pathology services or information at a distance for assessment, intervention and/or consultation.

fields.name: interstate_compact_member
fields.description: Whether the state has enacted the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact, enabling multistate practice privileges.
fields.sample_quote: Chapter 41a, Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact

fields.name: compact_privilege_adverse_action_waiting_period_years
fields.description: Number of years after an adverse action during which a licensee is ineligible to obtain a compact privilege in a remote state.
fields.sample_quote: Have not had any adverse action against any license or compact privilege within the previous 2 years from date of application

fields.name: privileged_communication_protected
fields.description: Whether the statute establishes a privileged-communication protection between the licensee and client, preventing compelled disclosure without client consent.
fields.sample_quote: A person licensed under this chapter may not be examined or required to reveal any findings, examinations, or representation made to the licensed person by the licensed person's client … without the consent of the client or the client's representative.

fields.name: school_credential_exemption
fields.description: Whether persons holding a valid state education credential are exempt from licensure when practicing solely within a school setting.
fields.sample_quote: a person who has obtained a valid and current credential issued by the State Board of Education while specifically performing the functions of a speech-language pathologist or audiologist solely within the confines of … the school employing the person

fields.name: federal_employee_exemption
fields.description: Whether persons employed by federal government agencies are exempt from state licensure when providing services solely within that agency.
fields.sample_quote: a person employed as a speech-language pathologist or audiologist by federal government agencies or subdivisions … while specifically performing speech-language pathology or audiology services solely within the confines of … the agency or subdivision

fields.name: newborn_hearing_screening_exemption
fields.description: Whether persons trained in newborn hearing screening and working under indirect audiologist supervision are exempt from full licensure.
fields.sample_quote: a person who is … trained in newborn hearing screening … and working under the indirect supervision of a licensed audiologist responsible for a newborn hearing screening program
